result:
These are just build artifacts from verification (fine to leave, or the harness can regenerate them). Everything checks out. Here's the summary:

## What was wrong

This SaaS pivoted from an email-cleanup product ("InboxZap") to an AI meeting assistant ("Lumina"), but the migration was left half-finished:

- **Critical bug**: `app/layout.tsx` still rendered the old "InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes" title/description/OG tags on *every page*, while all visible content talked about Lumina. Mismatched titles directly hurt CTR and send Google mixed signals about site relevance.
- The GSC export is **entirely legacy data** — "inboxzap," "bulk delete emails," "gmail storage," etc. These are from the dead product and would be a trap to chase; none of it is relevant to Lumina's actual market.
- The 12 old blog posts (`/blog/post-1..12`) are about email cleanup, get impressions but ~0% CTR, and have no path forward — not worth salvaging.
- `/blog` was a client-only component fetching a nonexistent `/api/posts` → infinite spinner, zero crawlable content, no `[slug]` route existed at all.
- `sitemap.ts` explicitly excluded blog posts (TODO left in place).
- `/features` and `/pricing` were linked in nav but had no routes in the repo (would 404).
- `/faq` was linked everywhere but 404'd — the configured redirect pointed to a `/#faq` anchor that doesn't exist anywhere.

## What I fixed

- Corrected `layout.tsx` metadata/OG/Twitter tags to match the real product, added `metadataBase` + canonical, and added Organization/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD to the homepage.
- Rebuilt the blog as real server-rendered pages (`app/blog/page.tsx`, `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, `app/blog/posts.ts`) with per-post metadata, canonicals, and Article JSON-LD — no more client-fetch dependency.
- Wrote 4 new posts targeting Lumina's actual audience (AI meeting notes, cross-platform transcription, action-item follow-through, async vs. live meetings) instead of reviving irrelevant content.
- Recreated `/features` and `/pricing` as real routes with proper metadata.
- Built a real `/faq` page with FAQPage schema and removed the dead redirect.
- Updated `sitemap.ts` to include features/pricing/faq/blog + every post, pulled dynamically from the post data.
- Verified with a full `next build` + `next start` smoke test — all routes 200, titles/canonicals/schema all correct.

Also worth flagging separately: `npm install` warned that `next@14.2.5` has a known security vulnerability and should be upgraded — unrelated to SEO but worth a ticket.

Next-phase ideas I didn't execute (would need your sign-off on scope): competitor comparison pages (Lumina vs. Otter/Fireflies/Fathom), and re-verifying/resubmitting the new sitemap in GSC under the current brand once this ships, since the existing GSC property only has historical data for the old product.
